description: Reads and writes the Thunderbird settings that the add-on syncs between devices: global preferences, account and identity settings, and message filters.

functions.name: readSettings
functions.description: Returns { values, servers, identities, accounts }: the synced settings that are set on this device, the account ids (type:user@host) and identity addresses present here, and a map from account key to account id.

functions.name: supportedKeys
functions.description: The keys from the list that this device can sync (known setting, account or identity present).

functions.name: applySettings
functions.description: Writes the given values (null clears a setting). Returns { failed: { key: reason } }.

functions.name: applyRecommended
functions.description: Turns on HTML compose and the reply above the quote for every identity, and the Cards View. Returns { changed: [{ what (html, replyOnTop, cardsView), identity }] }.

functions.name: collectContacts
functions.description: Adds the people you wrote to or replied to (in mail dated since options.since, in seconds; 0 for all mail) to Collected Addresses, skipping addresses already in an address book, and merges Collected Addresses contacts that share an address. Returns { scanned, folders, people, added, merged, book }.
